result.title: Melange: A Synthetic Visual Bias Benchmark for Multi-modal Large Language Models
result.summary: Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have seen broad adoption, but their biases are still far less examined than those of standard LLMs, creating possible social harms when deployed in real-world settings. Prior efforts to extend bias analyses from LLMs into the multi-modal space either cover only a few bias categories or do not ensure that the groups being compared are clearly addressed by visual cues in the images. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Melange, a wide-ranging synthetic visual benchmark covering seven categories for assessing social biases in MLLMs. It is grounded in the widely used language-only BBQ dataset (Bias Benchmark for Question Answering) from BigBench, carefully extending its constructed contexts via controlled generation of visual scenarios so the target attributes appear visually and clearly. To maximize reliability, our generated images pass through two stages of validation: automated screening using visual question answering (VQA) and subsequent manual inspection by human annotators. By systematically evaluating 23 open-source MLLMs across three matched evaluation settings---text-only, image-only, and image-with-context---Melange isolates the fairness effect of the input modality. Switching from text to vision reduces fairness by 0.291 on average, a gap that varies by model family rather than by scale alone. A perception control confirms that this gap is not an artifact of visual comprehension: models identify the depicted attributes at 90--95\% accuracy yet still fail to abstain. When models do commit to a biased answer, polarity-aware stereotype alignment shows they choose the human-stereotypical response roughly three-quarters of the time.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建 Melange：基于 BBQ 受控生成覆盖七类社会偏见的合成视觉场景，经 VQA 自动筛选与人工复核，并在文本、图像、图文三种匹配设置下评测 23 个开源 MLLM，配合感知控制分析视觉输入对公平性的影响。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「属性可被识别却仍不作弃答」的感知控制与三模态匹配设计，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据是否真正进入决策这一问题，但论文主题是偏见与公平性而非 latent 推理，需较多核查。
